per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should have a clear, intuitive, and standard layout with easily recognizable labels and minimal steps for booking a room.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall use a standard navigation menu familiar to most web users.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Routine tasks such as booking a room should be completed in approximately 5 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: New users should be able to start using the system successfully without training within 15 minutes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'An employee will be able to successfully use the product within a few minutes. After informally navigating the product for less than 15 minutes users shall be able to successfully setup meetings and reserve conference rooms.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should prevent double-bookings by accurately showing room availability.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall allow for intuitive searching of available conference rooms.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be accessible to users with disabilities, including support for screen readers, keyboard navigation, and high-contrast displays.
The system should automatically adjust date and time formats to local conventions based on the user's location.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product shall be able to display calendar dates and times according to the user's locale. 90% of survey respondents from each target market country will find that the date and time formatting of the product is correct.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be highly available during business hours, with minimal downtime.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should reliably send email invites and reminders without duplicates.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with various email servers. The product shall be able to send email.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be compatible with the most common browsers used within the company, approximately eight different browsers.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser. The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support localization, including translations of labels and local date and time formats.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product shall be able to display calendar dates and times according to the user's locale. 90% of survey respondents from each target market country will find that the date and time formatting of the product is correct.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide clear and explicit notifications for cancellations and errors.
The system should prioritize functionality over fancy visuals.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall use a standard navigation menu familiar to most web users.'
